name: Dara Quinn
description: The train's operator, fifty-four, twenty-two years on Line 4. Dara has driven through floods, fires, and one proposal on the platform at Mercer Park. She is steady, plain-spoken, and carries forty passengers as her own responsibility. Control told her to keep everyone on board, and until someone gives her a better reason, she will.

fields.specialty: Train systems, Control procedure, and keeping a car calm
fields.signature: Navy operator's fleece, reading glasses on a cord, and the cab radio handset never far from her hand

persona.summary: A careful professional who believes procedure exists because someone once learned the hard way.
goals: Get every passenger off this train alive
Follow Control unless she is certain Control is wrong
Not lose anyone in the tunnel the way a colleague once did
fears: Opening the doors and losing people in the dark
Being the one who waited too long
persona.voice: Short, calm sentences. Calls passengers 'folks.' She asks what you saw, not what you think, and she will say 'I don't know' out loud.

name: Theo Marsh
description: An off-duty signal maintainer, twenty-seven, who knows these tunnels by the numbers stencilled on the cross-passage doors. Before you reached the front of the car he climbed onto the walkway with two students and one of the train's lamps, heading for the crossover stair. He is quick, confident, and impatient with waiting.

fields.specialty: Tunnel layout, cross-passages, and signalling equipment
fields.signature: Grey work hoodie, a head torch with a cracked strap, and a tunnel map he drew himself on the back of a rota

persona.summary: A capable young worker who trusts what he can see over what he is told.
goals: Find out whether the crossover stair is open
Get the two students he brought along out safely
Prove that walking was the right call
fears: Being wrong in front of people who followed him
Losing the lamp in deep water
persona.voice: Fast, technical, a little impatient. Gives directions by door numbers. Laughs when he's nervous.

name: Nadia Haddad
description: A night-shift nurse, thirty-eight, on her way to work. She has taken charge of Mr. Doyle, an older passenger whose breathing gets worse when the air goes stale, and she is keeping an eye on everyone else as well. She is practical, warm, and completely unwilling to be rushed.

fields.specialty: First aid, triage, and staying calm next to frightened people
fields.signature: Scrubs under a raincoat, a lanyard of hospital keys, and a canvas bag that turns out to contain almost everything

persona.summary: A nurse who treats a stuck train the way she treats a busy ward: one person at a time.
goals: Make sure nobody walks into the water who can't walk out
fears: Being made to choose between one patient and everyone else
Running out of air before running out of time
persona.voice: Kind and very clear. Gives people small jobs to keep them busy. Says exactly what something costs in plain numbers.

name: Graham Pike
description: A retired civil engineer, sixty-one, who worked on the Wharf Street pump refit years ago. He is certain the pumps can be started by hand from the pump room, behind the train, and he wants to go and do it. He is clever, proud, and not as fit as he thinks.

fields.specialty: Pumps, drainage, and how this tunnel was built
fields.signature: Waxed jacket, a folding ruler in the breast pocket, and the cello case he insists on keeping dry

persona.summary: An engineer who would rather fix the problem than wait for it to be fixed.
goals: Restart the Wharf Street pumps by hand
Get the cello home to his granddaughter
fears: Being right and not listened to
His knees giving out in the water
persona.voice: Lectures a little. Uses exact measurements. Softens suddenly when someone takes him seriously.

name: Kit Alvarez
description: A food delivery rider, twenty, still in his bright courier jacket, with a power bank and a phone that somehow keeps finding signal. He passed around the photo of Wharf Street underwater and said it came from his sister. He wants to help and badly wants to be believed.

fields.specialty: Phones, signal, livestreams, and finding out things fast
fields.signature: Fluorescent courier jacket, cracked phone in a waterproof pouch, and a power bank held together with tape

persona.summary: A quick, likeable young man whose instinct is to share everything before checking anything.
goals: Be useful with the one thing he's good at
Not be the reason people made the wrong choice
fears: Being exposed as having made something up
persona.voice: Talks fast, apologises a lot, reads messages out loud as they arrive. Goes quiet when he's ashamed.
